text:
sam.sales: Quick one 1 AuroraMed wants to drop vendor docs into their procurement portal before the exec review. They asked for SOC2 excerpt, ISO page, a pen-test attestation letter, and whether they can run an authenticated scan during the 10-day POC.
noah.se: We can provide SOC2 Type II cover/excerpt and ISO 27001 certificate page + scope statement. Pen-test: signed attestation + 1-page exec summary only. No raw reports.
trina.security: Authenticated scans are allowed only on dedicated or isolated staging endpoints with: pre-approved test plan, IP allowlist, supervised window, signed NDA addendum, and rate limits. No destructive testing, no persistent test accounts.
maria.ops: I can create a time-limited presigned S3 bundle or SFTP credentials if they insist. Need the recipient emails and legal entity name for signed attestation.
sam.sales: Legal name is "AuroraMed Global, Inc.". They prefer portal SFTP upload.
trina.security: Copy/paste checklist for procurement portal:
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover/excerpt PDF (no audit working papers)
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1-page exec summary (no raw reports)
- High-level network diagram (redacted)
- KMS & encryption controls one-pager
- Pre-scan requirements: test plan, source IPs, test window, scope (staging/dedicated), signed NDA addendum
- Delivery options: presigned S3 link or SFTP (time-limited)
- Contact for SOW/ supervised-test quote
```
noah.se: Lead times: 2-4 business days for standard pack, 7-12 if legal redlines required. Pricing blurb to paste: "Standard enterprise POC includes the basic assurance pack. Supervised scans, legal redaction, and extensive audit support billed via SOW; indicative small engagements start at $5k."
evidence-bot: Ticket created: EVID-8110. presign artefact queued.
sam.sales: I'll ask for test IPs and preferred windows and send the checklist now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
